entities.summary: Daniel Paul Coulombe  is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Boston Red Sox of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Oakland Athletics, Baltimore Orioles, Minnesota Twins, and Texas Rangers.
